verdict.rationale: Working Copy's docs clearly describe the core commit-and-push workflow (staging/committing via the Changes/Status tab, pushing over https/ssh/git protocols, amend/squash, and a real user account of pulling, editing, and pushing on the go). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of push reliability/conflict scenarios beyond a single anecdote, and no first-party benchmark or detailed push-error handling documentation.
